mapper.select: SELECT user_id, default_dining_count, created_at, updated_at FROM user_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT id FROM app_user WHERE id = #{userId} FOR KEY SHARE

INSERT INTO user_profile(user_id, default_dining_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{defaultDiningCount,jdbcType=INTEGER}) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET default_dining_count = EXCLUDED.default_dining_count, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP RETURNING user_id, default_dining_count, created_at, updated_at
